{{Quote|They made it out! Bola and Uthril and Nug, they escaped in the confusion!|[[Uli Zhensi]]|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Art of Interrogation|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>}}
'''Nug''' was an individual working as a mechanic for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Project Threshold]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Together with [[Uli Zhensi]], [[Bola (individual)|Bola]] and [[Uthril]], Nug became disgusted with the Empire's torture techniques and tried to sabotage the project. However, their plan was discovered and only Uli managed to escape. He later recruited a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] citizen to finish their work and destroy the project, the task that helped Nug and the others escape in the confusion.<ref name="TOR" />
